```{=html}

<!-- Centered Page Wrapper -->
<div class="centered-content">
    <form id="blogForm" style="max-width: 800px; background: #ffffff; padding: 20px; margin-bottom: 30px;">
        <h1 style="text-align: center; color: #ab9f9e; font-size: 3rem">Post!</h1>
      <div style="margin-bottom: 15px;">
        <input type="text" id="postTitle" name="title" required placeholder="Add your title..." required style="width: 100%; padding: 8px; background-color: #f1f1f1; border: none !important; outline: none !important; color: #ab9f9e; box-sizing: border-box;">
      </div>
    
      <div style="margin-bottom: 15px;">
        <textarea id="postBody" name="body" rows="6" required placeholder="Write your thoughts..." required style="width: 100%; padding: 8px; background-color: #f1f1f1; border: none !important; outline: none !important; box-sizing: border-box;"></textarea>
      </div>
    
      <div style="margin-bottom: 15px;">
        <label for="postTag" style="display: block; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 5px; color: #ab9f9e;">Category Tag:</label>
        <select id="postTag" name="tag" required style="width: 100%; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #ccc; background-color: #f1f1f1; border-radius: 4px; box-sizing: border-box; color: #ab9f9e;">
          <option value="General">General</option>
          <option value="Random">Random</option>
          <option value="Shower Thoughts">Shower Thoughts</option>
          <option value="Self Help">Self Help</option>
          <option value="The Bluest Eye">The Bluest Eye</option>
        </select>
      </div>
    
      <button type="submit" class="btn-submit" style="background-color: #7d3028; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 15px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold;">Submit</button>
    </form>
    
    <script>
    document.getElementById('blogForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
    
      const title = encodeURIComponent(document.getElementById('postTitle').value);
      const rawBody = document.getElementById('postBody').value;
      const tag = document.getElementById('postTag').value;
    
      // Format the issue body to store content and tag cleanly
      const issueBody = encodeURIComponent(`---TAG---\n${tag}\n---CONTENT---\n${rawBody}`);
    
      // Make sure your username and repo name match EXACTLY (case-sensitive!)
      const issueUrl = `https://github.com/JaydenJMerrick/ashana-blog/issues/new?title=${title}&body=${issueBody}&labels=blog-post`;
      window.location.href = issueUrl;
    });
    </script>
</div>
```
